chapter: Mambo, the Palladium and Cubop City
title: Moving from Mercury to Columbia with Mitch Miller
summary: Mitch Miller took them to Columbia's international department, where they recorded "Hobo Mambo" produced by Percy Faith.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: I see. Okay, all right. You left Mercury records in 1950. I believe that Mitch Miller ....
Mitch Miller was the musical diretior or the producer of Mercury.....

... so when he finished his contract with Mercury, he knew that Mercury was going to discontinue the Latin department; so he took us to Columbia because he was made the head man of our recording production.
Was Noro Morales already with Columbia at the time?
... but it was in a different department.
I see. Okay, so what happened?
So this was the international department and Noro was in the domestic department.....
So we went to Columbia with Mitch Miller and he record with us "Hobo Mambo" .....
... and Percy Faith was the producer of our record.
Yes, 78's and then they put them in the album.
